sanitizer.scope: full production Fmp4V2Bridge, RawFlacBridge and ResourceSource

pcmOracle.compared: independent integer input vs PCM decoded from virtual fMP4; compressed packet SHA-256, presentation clocks and decoded sample counts compared to native FLAC

initialAttempts.resolution: Use independent decoded frame nb_samples and packet timebases; no duration invented
initialAttempts.finalWindowsSelection: Five legacy CTest groups, followed by three exact raw FLAC groups; both selections checked independently
initialAttempts.tightening: Reject negative LPC shift per RFC 9639; add independent constant/verbatim/fixed/LPC frames; rebuild and repeat all final runtime rows

limits: One required native FLAC resource/audio track, fixed blocks, mono/stereo, 16/24-bit, 44100/48000 Hz
Known duration and zero offset; contiguous SHA-confirmed prefix; initial byte length may be unknown
Metadata 1 MiB/128 blocks, frame 1 MiB/250000 frames, initial prefix and each append 16 MiB
Metadata types 1-6 skipped in decoder view, no new cover or tag extraction
Packet/PCM equality is not physical audio-output certification
Variable blocks, other containers/layouts/rates/depths, segments/live and real Harvester integration remain open
